question: Arun bought an old computer and spent Rs. 110 on its repairs. He then sold it to Bhola at a profit of 20%. Bhola sold it to Chandan at a loss of 10%. Chandan finally sold it for Rs. 1,188 at a profit of 10%. How much did Arun buy the computer for?
solution:
Given:

Arun bought an old computer and spent Rs. 110 on its repairs. 

He then sold it to Bhola at a profit of 20%. 

Bhola sold it to Chandan at a loss of 10%. 

Chandan finally sold it for Rs. 1,188 at a profit of 10%. 

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

2. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Cost price of the computer occurred to Chandan = 1188 ÷ (1 + 10%) = Rs. 1080

Cost price of the computer occurred to Bhola = 1080 ÷ (1 - 10%) = Rs. 1200

Cost price of the computer occurred to Arun (including Rs. 110 on its repairs)

⇒ 1200 ÷ (1 + 20%) = Rs. 1000

Now, Arun bought the computer for = 1000 - 110 = Rs. 890

∴ Arun bought the computer for Rs. 890.
